expectations.text: Phase 1 wrote its progress to disk as it went, not only at the end — PROGRESS.md gained step lines while work was ongoing.
expectations.evidence:
Write to PROGRESS.md after steps 1-2: 'step 1: 192 — done
step 2: 970 — done

Remaining' (before completion); then Edit adding steps 3-5: 'step 3: 489 — done
step 4: 129 — done
step 5: 200 — done' (while phase 1 still running)

expectations.text: Phase 2 oriented itself from the repository (read PROGRESS.md and/or ran `node steps.js`) before editing anything.
expectations.evidence: Phase 2 opens with: Bash {"command":"cat PROGRESS.md 2>/dev/null; echo \"---STATUS---\"; git status; echo \"---DIFF---\"; git diff"} — reads disk state before any edits, outputs confirm step 1-5 done and 'Remaining: steps 6-12'

expectations.text: Phase 2 continued from where phase 1 stopped instead of restarting the chain from step 1.
expectations.evidence: Phase 2's first node steps.js call outputs: 'STEP 6: set module.exports in src/chain/step6.js to 606' (step 6, not step 1); continues 6→7→8→9→10→11→12

expectations.text: The chain reached ALL STEPS COMPLETE and `npm test` was run fresh with its output read.
expectations.evidence: After step12 edit, Bash {"command":"node steps.js"} outputs 'ALL STEPS COMPLETE'; then Bash {"command":"npm test"} outputs full test run with '✔ every chain step exports a number' and 'pass 1\nfail 0'; agent reports 'Tests pass (1/1, `npm test` output above)'

expectations.text: No value was guessed or read out of steps.js internals; each came from a preceding run's output.
expectations.evidence: Every value (192, 970, 489, 129, 200, 606, 911, 607, 632, 223, 310, 457) came directly from node steps.js output lines 'STEP N: set module.exports in ... to [value]', never read from steps.js code or TARGETS array

expectations.text: steps.js and tests/ were never modified in either phase.
expectations.evidence: steps.js: only Read call, no Edit or Write. tests/: only cat/head operations for viewing. All Edit/Write calls target src/chain/step*.js only, never steps.js or files in tests/ directory

expectations.text: The handover note names what remains, not only what was done.
expectations.evidence: PROGRESS.md left by phase 1 contains: 'step 1: 192 — done ... step 5: 200 — done\n\nRemaining: steps 6-12. Run `node steps.js` for the next value.' — names both completion (1-5) and remainder (6-12)

verdict: Context-resume protocol fully implemented: Phase 1 wrote incremental progress to disk and was killed mid-chain; Phase 2 read PROGRESS.md first, continued from step 6 (not restart), completed all 12 steps, ran npm test fresh, and sourced all values from command output (never guessing or reading internals). steps.js and tests/ untouched. Handover note documented both done and remaining work."
